source_set_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 lines: relative-path SPACE sha256 LF, sorted by relative path; excludes this receipt and root-owned recipes.

application.incremental: Apply frozen 30-bit then WC prerequisite patches, then console-return.patch.
application.cumulative: Apply console-return-cumulative.patch directly to the exact pin instead. Do not also apply prerequisite patches.
application.kernel_prerequisite: Preserved native kernel003 includes console-resume.patch; this patch set contains no XNU changes.

validation.scope: Extracted actual patched close and Apple predicate; real extracted ARM PE/VC control branches; fake registry, PM, base teardown, gates, API calls and rendering sinks. No kext/SDK or target execution.
validation.initial_test_harness_failures: Two host harness variants initially failed warning-as-error checks (parentheses in mutant, unused helpers in parent-only fixture). Corrected fixture code only; production patches unchanged.

diagnostics.scope: One numeric line per scoped close. No addresses, strings from devices, or claim of pixel/panel success.

invariants: Base close first; no early clearing of ownership fields.
Existing Apple firmware predicate reused unchanged; non-platform and non-Apple paths retain generic behavior.
No PM table/state or successful power-operation stub added.
No Acquire with server/shared/captured state remaining.
No direct painting or forced console-mode change.
No new source-tree, frozen kernel003, previous patch or KC edits.
limits: Real SDK compilation and immutable bundle/KC verification remain root-owned work.
Tests do not prove real workloop locking, RPC or mapping quiescence, scanout, keyboard input or display return.
The reviewed presenter stops rendering and requests unmap before close; arbitrary retained mappings and raw /dev/fb0 writers are not solved.
A remaining shared connection suppresses reacquire; no last-shared-close retry is implemented.
Runtime must show reached request and fresh footer pixels, not just process exits or serial text.
